'''Donald Turner Sawyer''' (January 10, 1931 – {{circa|2017}}) was an American [[chemist]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://scalacs.org/?page_id=1427|title=1982 Donald T. Sawyer, UCR|work=Southern California Local Section|access-date=August 28, 2026}}</ref> He was a [[distinguished professor]] in the department of [[chemistry]] at the [[University of California, Riverside]].<ref name="a">{{Citation|title=Faculties, Publications, and Doctoral Theses in Chemistry and Chemical Engineering at United States Universities|page=762|publisher=American Chemical Society. Committee on Professional Training|date=1991}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|title=ACS Directory of Graduate Research 1993|page=779|date=1993|publisher=American Chemical Society|author=American Chemical Society. Committee on Professional Training}}</ref>

In 1978, Sawyer was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=sawyer&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=August 28, 2026}}</ref>

Sawyer died in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://memorial.ucr.edu/2017-memorial|title=Memorial 2017|work=[[University of California, Riverside]]|access-date=November 6, 2026}}</ref>
